decision: Start the already selected representation-preserving pilot as the highest-value executable item. Its source/reuse phase is authorized now; scientific inputs, generated bytes and checker launches remain separately gated within the same item. Retain the one-thread source assessment as a feasible lower-value reserve and leave all PLANNED candidates unstarted.

categories.assessment: The active representation pilot offers a reusable relation, tooling and cross-profile matrix; the historical one-thread assessment remains narrower reserve work.
The selected pilot can create shared original/variant pairs and an independent preservation audit. The reserve addresses only one retained operational survivor question.
No fresh upstream request displaces the selected local pilot. Held contributions retain their existing preflight and approval gates; neither executable candidate performs an external write.
The selected pilot explicitly begins with a bounded primary-source and reuse review; this is more current and method-relevant than starting the source-only reserve.
Both executable candidates can start locally. The selected pilot's format, preservation-oracle and profile questions are bounded phase gates rather than reasons to switch items.

candidates.rationale: Selected and now ACTIVE: a legal representation relation offers broader fresh-input and shared-method value than the historical one-thread reserve while preserving exact downstream gates.
READY reserve: the source-only operational question remains feasible, but it has a narrower evidence and shared-asset surface than the active representation pilot.
